# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis has a plump, showy figure and a brilliant complexion that gives her a real showy look with snap and color. She features large, bright-blue eyes and wears her long yellow hair in a braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who frankly enjoys the pleasant things of life, though she can be sentimental and prone to hysterics. She is strongly focused on romance, intending to have many young men infatuated with her when she grows up and planning to have a beau as soon as she turns fifteen. While she plans to study to become a teacher, she intends to teach for only two years before getting married. She also harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis was known among her peers for having many older sisters and for once using a magic pebble to charm away her warts. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, Ruby and her classmates welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back warmly. Ruby later visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was recovering from a broken ankle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Quotes

> "I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "It makes me feel frightened, girls. Do you suppose it’s really right to act like this? Mrs. Lynde says that all play-acting is abominably wicked."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

> "What are you going to wear for commencement, Jane?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P16](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0016)

> "Nor I,"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "Oh, she does look really dead,"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school after a period away, Ruby and their fellow classmates greet her with warm welcomes and exchange gifts with her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), +2 more_
